items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: He used to make that organ sing. And that's how I started playing organ.

ctx.x: With Sara Lou Harris. Sara Lou Harris is now married to the Ambassador to Guyana(?). She is now Lady Carter in the English... She has a share in the British (?).
Well, after hours you would go to the Club Harlem, and you heard Wild Bill Davis at Little Belmont.
